hotel.name: Metro Business Hotel Whitefield
hotel.tagline: A business hotel near ITPL, Bengaluru
hotel.address: ITPL Main Road, Whitefield, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560066, India

rooms.name: Executive King Room
rooms.description: Quiet room with a large work desk and fast Wi-Fi.

rooms.name: Studio Suite
rooms.description: Studio with a kitchenette for longer business stays.

knowledge.title: Check-in and check-out times
knowledge.content: Check-in is from 3:00 PM (15:00) and check-out is by 12:00 noon. Late check-out until 3:00 PM costs INR 2,000, subject to availability.

knowledge.title: Swimming pool
knowledge.content: The hotel does not have a swimming pool. Guests can use the 24-hour gym on the second floor free of charge.

knowledge.title: Cancellation policy
knowledge.content: Bookings can be cancelled free of charge until 6:00 PM on the day before arrival. Later cancellations and no-shows are charged one night.

knowledge.title: Breakfast and dining
knowledge.content: Breakfast is included in all room rates and served from 6:30 AM to 10:00 AM at the Ledger Cafe, which also serves lunch and dinner until 11:00 PM.

knowledge.title: Contacting the hotel
knowledge.content: The front desk is available 24 hours: phone +91 80 5550 0199, WhatsApp +91 98450 55502, or email frontdesk@metrobusiness.example.
